    select_experts_tie_keys = 0xffffffff - select_experts_source_positions.to(tl.uint32)
    select_experts_keys = tl.where(True, (select_experts_ordered_scores.to(tl.uint64) << 32) | select_experts_tie_keys.to(tl.uint64), 0)
